## Engineering & Technology Stack
- **Frontend:** React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Vite, FontAwesome, Bootstrap Icons, Canvas Confetti.
- **Backend & APIs:** Python 3.12, FastAPI, Pydantic, Uvicorn, RESTful API Architecture.
- **Integrations:** n8n Workflow Automation Engine, Google Apps Script Cloud Webhook, Stripe Payments, HubSpot / Pipedrive CRM, vCard 3.0 Standard.
- **Cloud & DevOps:** Docker, CI/CD automated pipelines, cloud deployments on AWS/Vercel/Google Cloud, SLA 99.98%.

## Core Value Propositions
- **Scale your Business:** Robust architecture ready for massive traffic and user growth.
- **Grow your Revenue:** High-converting digital interfaces engineered to generate new revenue streams.
- **Cut Operational Costs:** Intelligent automated workflows connecting CRMs, messaging, and LLM AI agents.
- **Faster Time-to-Market:** Agile sprints with weekly demos and continuous production deployments.
